scenes.narration: Day four. The shutter is bending. Mia is thirsty. And then you remember the back room.
scenes.visual: you turn toward the back room door

scenes.narration: The water heater. Every building has one. And the tank is full of clean water. This one holds forty gallons.
scenes.visual: the water heater tank, 40 GALLONS label

scenes.narration: First, you switch off its power at the breaker, so it can't heat an empty tank.
Then you open a hot water tap, so air can get in.
Then you twist the drain valve at the bottom... and water pours out. Clear. Clean.
scenes.visual: drain valve, water filling a bottle

scenes.narration: Mia drinks a whole bottle without stopping. Then she laughs. First time in four days.
Forty gallons. That's weeks, for two people, if you're careful.
You stack every shelf against the front shutter. And you wait.
Day five. Day six. You teach Mia card games. She wins every one.
Day seven. A sound you haven't heard in a week. Engines. A loudspeaker.
Anyone inside, make yourself known. And there's a knock. Three knocks.
Soldiers. Water trucks. And the sun... coming up over the parking lot.
Mia holds your hand the whole way to the truck. She doesn't let go once.
scenes.visual: you and Mia walking to the truck

scenes.narration: The water heater trick is real. In an emergency, it could save your life. Knew that? Tell me in the comments... and follow. Tomorrow... a new story.
scenes.visual: end card: KNEW THAT? / NEW STORY TOMORROW
